actionItems: Design team to evaluate cost of voice recognition versus whistle option and finalize by end of week
UI and materials team to create mockups with fruit/vegetable color themes and rubberized surface by Friday
Product team to confirm logo placement and visibility in final design by Thursday
keyPoints: Kinetic charging selected as primary power solution; solar and dynamo rejected for design, cost, and usability issues
Design features a flip-top LCD screen, rubberized buttons on the bottom, and a removable rubberized outer shell for customization
Aesthetic focuses on fruit/vegetable-inspired colors and premium, tactile feel; no actual fruit shapes
User preference for physical buttons over touchscreens; frequent users find them more reliable and durable
Key decisions include plastic internal body, rubber grip, and a visible, prominent company logo
summary.summary: The team finalized a remote design featuring kinetic charging, a black-and-white LCD screen, rubberized buttons, and a plastic internal shell with a removable rubberized exterior. The device emphasizes a fancy, fruit-and-vegetable inspired aesthetic with vibrant, non-literal color schemes and a focus on tactile feel and visual distinctiveness. Voice recognition and solar/dynamo options were rejected due to cost and practicality, with a whistle as a potential fallback. The design prioritizes user experience, long battery life, and market differentiation through premium look and feel.
summary.title: Remote Design Finalized
